traces: Evaluate n²+n+1 mod7 residues 0..6: 1,3,0,6,0,3,1. Roots 2 and4. 1000=7*142+6 so each root occurs143 times (last roots996 and998). Total286. Explain residues and 142 full blocks plus final residues1..6 two extra.
answer:
The value of \(n^2+n+1\) modulo \(7\) depends only on the remainder of \(n\):

\[
\begin{array}{c|rrrrrrr}
n\bmod 7&0&1&2&3&4&5&6\\ \hline
(n^2+n+1)\bmod 7&1&3&0&6&0&3&1
\end{array}
\]

Thus, the condition holds exactly when \(n\equiv2\) or \(4\pmod7\).

Since \(1000=7\cdot142+6\), there are \(142\) complete blocks of seven integers, each contributing two solutions. The remaining six integers also include both qualifying remainders.

Therefore, the answer is
\[
\boxed{2\cdot142+2=286}.
\]
